description:
This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we’re just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we’re scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

Our models are already seeing strong inbound demand, and we’re expanding our commercial team to accelerate adoption across enterprise and strategic partners.

We’re looking for someone who can translate deep technical interest into durable, long-term partnerships  especially across complex, non-standard engagements involving APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing.

This role owns the end-to-end commercial journey, working closely with research, engineering, and leadership to help customers move confidently from evaluation to production.

What You’ll Work On

  • Own the full sales cycle from discovery through close and expansion across startups, scaleups, and enterprises

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving technical buyers, executives, and legal teams

  • Design and execute sales motions across APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing

  • Build durable customer relationships that drive retention and long-term expansion

  • Partner closely with solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineers, product, research, and legal on bespoke deals

  • Translate customer needs and market signals into actionable feedback for product and research

  • Help define early commercial processes, playbooks, and qualification frameworks as we scale

What We’re Looking For

You’ve closed real, technically complex B2B deals and know how to operate without a playbook.

You bring strong judgment navigating long sales cycles, highly competitive environments with ambiguous requirements, and evolving products, and you’re comfortable working cross-functionally to get deals done the right way, not just quickly.

You'll likely have:

  • Experience selling technical products to tech executives, ML teams, and enterprise stakeholders

  • Ability to discuss model capabilities, inference requirements, and integration tradeoffs with technical buyers

  • Proven success managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing strategic landmark deals

  • Strong negotiation skills across pricing, licensing, and custom commercial terms

  • Track record building and scaling pipelines across different deal sizes and customer types

  • Comfort shaping process and structure in fast-moving, early-stage environments

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

EU €150,000 - €185,000 + variable + equity

US $180,000 - $210,000 USD + variable + equity

title: Director Product Technology Distribution Transformer (m/f/d)
description:
Transform with us the future of energy ⚡

The SGB‑SMIT Group is an international transformer manufacturer with locations in Europe, Asia and America. With reliable transformer technology, the company actively supports the global energy transition in areas such as renewable energy, industry and urban energy infrastructure.

As a key link between power generation, transmission and distribution, SGB‑SMIT Group develops and manufactures power transformers, distribution transformers, cast‑resin transformers and custom solutions for data centers, industrial applications and e‑mobility. These products ensure efficient, stable and secure energy flows worldwide.

With more than 3,800 employees worldwide, the SGB‑SMIT Group stands for quality, innovation and sustainability and offers a stable environment to work on technologies that shape the energy systems of the future.

What sets the SGB-SMIT Group apart: 🌍

We combine the strength of an international technology company with an employee-oriented corporate culture:

  • Meaningful work at the heart of the energy transition

  • Short decision-making processes and direct cooperation

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

Your contribution counts – both professionally and personally.

Your benefits at SGB-SMIT Group: 🚀

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

  • Attractive salary and social benefits

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working models

  • 30+1 vacation days plus special leave

  • Training and development opportunities

  • Company pension plan and employee insurance

  • Health and fitness offers (HanseFit)

  • Company restaurant, free drinks, and e-charging parking spaces

  • Bicycle and IT leasing

  • Subsidy for Germany/RVV ticket

  • Employee discounts via Benify

Your tasks: 📌

  • Define and execute the global Technology & Engineering strategy for Liquid-Immersed Distribution Transformers, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives and long-term growth plans.

  • Lead and develop a global Engineering organization across Operational Engineering and R&D, fostering a culture of innovation, technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.

  • Establish scalable organizational structures, engineering governance models and global operating frameworks to drive efficiency and engineering performance across multiple locations.

  • Drive technology roadmaps, product development initiatives and engineering transformation programs to strengthen competitiveness and accelerate innovation.

  • Build and leverage global synergies across Distribution Transformer technologies, engineering teams and product platforms to maximize knowledge sharing and standardization.

  • Own engineering standards, design governance and compliance with international regulations, quality requirements and industry best practices.

  • Lead strategic engineering investments, resource allocation and budget planning to ensure effective execution of business and technology priorities.

  • Champion digital engineering, design automation and global engineering platforms to enhance productivity, scalability and product quality.

  • Partner closely with Operations, Product Management, Manufacturing and Executive Leadership to translate market demands into sustainable engineering solutions and product innovations.

  • Establish a high-performance engineering culture through talent development, succession planning, technical capability building and strong leadership across a global matrix organization.

Your profile: 🔎

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering (Power Engineering, High Voltage Engineering) or Physics, combined with a strong track record in engineering leadership within industrial or energy-related environments.

  • Extensive experience leading global Technology & Engineering organizations, ideally within the power transformer, electrical equipment or energy infrastructure industry.

  • Proven success in defining and executing technology, innovation and engineering strategies that drive business growth, operational excellence and product competitiveness.

  • Deep technical expertise in power and distribution transformer technologies, product development, operational engineering and international industry standards.

  • Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing global matrix organizations, developing high-performing teams and leading cross-functional stakeholders across multiple locations.

  • Strategic and entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to translate market, customer and technology trends into sustainable business and engineering solutions.

  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end value chain, including engineering, manufacturing, quality, project management and commercial requirements.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, executive presence, international mindset and willingness to travel globally.

If you value a dynamic, growing, and intercultural environment and enjoy hands-on work, then become part of the SGB-SMIT Group - transform with us the future of energy. ⚡

We look forward to receiving your application! ⚡

description:
Wir haben ambitionierte Ziele.
Werde ein Teil davon.

Von 0 auf 40 Teammitglieder – in fünf Jahren. Wir gehören als Mix aus Strategieberatung und Kreativagentur zu den am schnellsten wachsenden inhabergeführten Beratungsunternehmen Süddeutschlands und möchten unseren Weg auch in Zukunft erfolgreich fortsetzen.

Hinter unserem „wir“ steht dabei ein Kollektiv aus engagierten Persönlichkeiten, was vielseitiger nicht sein könnte. Von ehemaligen Unternehmensberatern renommierter internationaler Unternehmen wie Ernst & Young oder Porsche Consulting über kreative Designprofis und Content-Experten bis zur TikTok Influencerin oder dem studierten Videografen – wir sind in unseren Fähigkeiten unterschiedlich, haben aber doch eine große Gemeinsamkeit: den Anspruch, uns kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und herausragende Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen.

Wenn du Lust hast, in einem dynamischen und gleichermaßen etablierten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs Karriere zu machen und Teil eines jungen, ambitionierten und freundschaftlichen Teams zu werden, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Aufgaben

Dein Part in unserem Team.
Tätigkeiten.

So etwas wie einen typischen Arbeitstag gibt es bei uns nicht. Wir entwickeln uns als Unternehmen stets weiter und erwarten dies auch von dir. Dabei bieten wir dir ein breites und vielschichtiges Spektrum an Aufgaben, das wir gerne nach deinen individuellen Stärken gewichten können.

  • Entwicklung von Designs für verschiedene Kommunikationskanäle wie z.B. Print, Web oder Social Media
  • Konzeption von Webdesign und Umsetzung dieser in Pagebuildern (hier lernen wir dich von A bis Z ein)
  • Anwendung der Adobe-Designprogramme (z.B. Illustrator, InDesign etc.)
  • Weitere Tätigkeiten aus unserem Leistungsbereich, die dir Spaß und Freude bringen

Qualifikation

Rechtschreib- und Formulierungsfehler verursachen Juckreiz an deinem Körper?
Das ist schon mal gut.

Einen tadellosen Lebenslauf, Bestnoten und das Studium in der Tasche? Das ist gut und wird bei uns auch honoriert, muss aber nicht sein. Wir interessieren uns vor allem für dich als Menschen und prüfen immer individuell, ob deine Erwartungen, deine Skills und dein Drive zu uns passen. Eigenschaften wie selbstständiges Arbeiten, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Aufgeschlossenheit gegenüber Neuem solltest du dabei auf jeden Fall mitbringen.

Darüber hinaus bringt die Stelle folgendes Anforderungsprofil mit:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise mit einem Hintergrund in Design, Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaft oder einem ähnlichen Bereich
  • Du bist ein kreativer Kopf und hast ein Gefühl für gutes Design
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits Arbeitserfahrung bei Beratungen, Agenturen oder Personal (-marketing) Abteilungen von Unternehmen - Berufsanfänger sind auch willkommen!
  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Flexibilität, Zuverlässigkeit, Teamfähigkeit und Motivation sind Teil deiner Persönlichkeit

Benefits

Warum wir kein normaler Arbeitgeber sind.
Unser Profil.

Ja, wir fordern einiges von unseren Teammitgliedern, dafür haben wir aber auch einiges zu bieten. Wir vertrauen den Menschen, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sich jeder gemäß seinen individuellen Stärken und Schwächen weiterentwickeln kann. Wer hoch hinaus möchte, bekommt früh viel Verantwortung und Entwicklungschancen, wer sich noch unsicher ist, wo es hingehen soll, wird an die Hand genommen und erhält Orientierung. Wir sind keine Chefs, Mitarbeiter und Praktikanten, wir sind ein eingeschworenes Team, das zusammen an einem Strang zieht.

Darüber hinaus kannst du dich bei uns auf die folgenden Punkte freuen:

  • Attraktive Vergütungschancen und durchlässige Karrierestrukturen – bei uns bestimmen dein Einsatz und deine Leistung deinen künftigen Karriereweg
  • Eine steile Lernkurve als echter Benefit statt Buzzword – bei uns kümmern sich engagierte Mentoren von renommierten Unternehmensberatungen und Universitäten um deine Entwicklung
  • Arbeit mit Impact – profitiere von direktem Austausch mit Geschäftsführern unserer mittelständischen Kunden und arbeite so an Themen, die wirklich zügig und gewinnbringend umgesetzt werden
  • Flexibilität, die du dir verdienst – deine gute Arbeit wird nicht nur finanziell wertgeschätzt. Wir geben dir auch mit individuellen Home-Office-Möglichkeiten die Freiheiten, die du benötigst
  • Das passende Umfeld – ob „State of the Art“ in Sachen Ausstattung mit Laptop, Firmenhandy, höhenverstellbaren Tischen oder coolen Teamevents wie zuletzt z.B. Workation in Barcelona und Griechenland, Golfen oder Kochkursen. Bei TaxIt macht die Arbeit noch Spaß
  • Mehr von deinem Brutto – wir sorgen mit Zusatzleistungen wie einem Deutschlandticket, einem monatlichen 50€ Einkaufsgutschein oder der Fitnessstudiomitgliedschaft (Urban Sports Club) für mehr Netto vom Brutto auf deinem Konto

Jetzt bist du dran.
Bewerbungsprozess.

Es gibt Chancen im Leben, die man nicht verpassen sollte. Das ist eine davon. Schicke uns jetzt deine Bewerbung über das digitale Bewerbungsformular und lerne uns persönlich kennen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und melden uns innerhalb von 72h bei dir. 🚀

  • Flexibles Modell: Freelance mit ca. 2 fixen Drehtagen im Monat zum Start, fixe Zusammenarbeit, Teilzeit oder Festanstellung sind möglich

  • Fertiges Setup: Videograf, Darsteller und Editor stehen bereit, du kannst direkt kreativ loslegen und bekommst hier nach einem Probetag die Verantwortung, bedeutet Du kannst bestimmen was hier gemacht wird und echt gestalten!

  • Echte Wirkung: Deine Videos laufen direkt als Ads und treiben das Wachstum der größten Sales-Job-Plattform im DACH-Raum

  • Kurze Wege: Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung und schnelle Entscheidungen

Interesse?

Schick uns deine Bewerbung mit Portfolio bzw. Beispielen von Ads und Videos, die du konzipiert oder umgesetzt hast, sowie deinem gewünschten Modell (Freelance oder Anstellung) und deiner Verfügbarkeit.

Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Valve Lead Engineer
description:
About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Senior Valve Engineer (Technical Authority) based in Toulouse.

About the role

We are seeking a hands-on valve expert who will serve as Pangea’s company-wide technical authority for valves. The mission is to build the internal capability to specify, design, analyse, source, test, qualify, industrialise, and continuously improve critical valves for our propulsion systems.

The first priority will be to assess and internalise selected valves used on Nereus, starting where technically and commercially justified with HTP-compatible valves. The scope can then expand to other valve families and propulsion programmes based on risk, recurring cost, lead time, supply-chain dependence, and strategic value.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with strong technical leadership. You will work closely with Fluidics and across Systems, Design, Analysis, Materials, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test, and Operations, taking decisions from first principles and carrying them through to validated hardware.

Key responsibilities

· Act as Pangea’s technical reference for valves, owning design decisions, technical reviews, risk acceptance, and the valve technology roadmap across propulsion programmes.

· Define the valve internalisation strategy and prioritise candidates using performance, safety, development risk, recurring cost, lead time, supplier dependence, and manufacturing scalability.

· Lead the initial Nereus workstream for HTP-compatible solenoid valves: capture requirements and interfaces; benchmark make-versus-buy options; select concepts; and define the development and qualification plan.

· Own the full product lifecycle—from requirements, architecture, trade-offs, detailed design, analysis, materials and sealing selection through prototyping, testing, qualification, production release, and in-service improvement.

· Develop or approve valve sizing and dynamic models covering flow capacity and pressure drop, actuation force and margin, response time, leakage, thermal effects, friction, hysteresis, fatigue, wear, contamination sensitivity, and lifetime.

· Establish verification logic, acceptance criteria, instrumentation, test matrices, and qualification evidence for nominal, off-nominal, proof, endurance, environmental, and compatibility testing.

· Ensure compatibility with HTP and, as applicable, cryogenic, high-pressure, hot, reactive, or hazardous fluids through disciplined materials, cleanliness, sealing, lubrication, and contamination-control choices.

· Resolve difficult hardware problems through structured failure investigation, test-data interpretation, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and design iteration.

· Lead technical engagement with valve, actuator, coil, seal, and manufacturing suppliers; review proposals, drawings, analyses, process controls, inspection plans, qualification evidence, deviations, and non-conformances.

· Create reusable internal standards, design rules, calculation methods, test procedures, lessons learned, and product architectures, while mentoring engineers and raising valve competence across the company.

Initial Mandate

Build a credible make-versus-buy and development plan for Nereus HTP-compatible solenoid valves, close the highest-risk knowledge gaps with analysis and testing, and leave behind a repeatable internal valve-development capability.

What you need to be successful

Education

· Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, Fluid Mechanics, or a closely related engineering discipline.

· Additional specialization in fluid systems, cryogenics, mechanical design, tribology, sealing technology, materials, or control systems would be advantageous.

Experience

· 8 to 10 years or more of relevant engineering experience, with substantial direct ownership of valve or closely related fluid-control hardware.

· Demonstrated hands-on delivery of hardware from requirements and concept selection through detailed design, test, qualification, and production support.

· Deep experience with solenoid, pilot-operated, pneumatic, electro-mechanical, or comparable valves for demanding applications.

· Experience with high-pressure, reactive, hazardous, cryogenic, or high-temperature fluid systems; liquid rocket propulsion or space hardware experience is strongly preferred.

· Evidence of solving real valve failure modes and working directly with manufacturing, suppliers, inspection teams, test facilities, and non-conformance processes.

Technical expertise

· Strong command of valve architecture, fluid mechanics, actuation, sealing, tribology, tolerancing, material selection, cleanliness, and design for manufacture and assembly.

· Ability to size and analyse valves using appropriate analytical and numerical methods, and to correlate models with component and system test data.

· Proven capability investigating leakage, friction, hysteresis, pressure drop, response time, actuation margin, contamination, wear, fatigue, thermal effects, and lifetime.

· Working knowledge of qualification logic, reliability, FMEA, fracture and fatigue considerations, configuration control, and technical documentation for safety-critical hardware.

· Knowledge of HTP compatibility, decomposition hazards, compatible materials and seals, cleanliness, and safe test practices is highly valuable.

Leadership

· Strong technical ownership: comfortable making and documenting difficult decisions, while actively seeking challenge and evidence.

· System-level thinking, with the ability to connect valve behaviour to engine, propulsion-system, test-bench, and vehicle performance.

· Pragmatic judgement that balances technical excellence with safety, schedule, cost, manufacturability, maintainability, and qualification effort.

· Clear communication across disciplines and with suppliers, including the ability to turn ambiguous problems into structured plans and crisp technical requirements.

· Builder’s mindset: equally willing to work at a whiteboard, review a drawing, analyse data, inspect hardware, and support a test campaign.

Additional assets

Advanced education: Postgraduate specialisation in fluid mechanics, cryogenics, sealing, tribology, mechatronics, controls, or mechanical design.

Relevant sectors: Space propulsion, aerospace, energy, hydrogen, oil and gas, chemical processing, or other high-pressure and hazardous-fluid industries.

Specialised expertise: HTP service, cryogenic valves, high-pressure solenoid valves, pilot-operated architectures, sealing technologies, actuation systems, materials compatibility, cleanliness, or lifetime qualification.

You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. title: CDI - Facility Manager (F/H)
description:

title: Responsable Communication et marketing H/F
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

EDL est le leader indépendant des solutions informatiques pour les services d'imagerie médicale depuis plus de 30 ans.

Nos solutions sont aujourd'hui installées dans plus de 600 services médicaux et utilisées par plus de 15 000 utilisateurs en France et en Europe sur tous types de terminaux (tablette, mobile, navigateur et desktop).

Nous éditons des applications intégrées couvrant la gestion du service de radiologie, la diffusion des images, la dictée numérique et la reconnaissance vocale des comptes-rendus, la médecine nucléaire, le stockage et l'interprétation des examens, ainsi que la téléradiologie et l'intégration de différents moteurs d'intelligence artificielle.

Rejoindre EDL, c'est intégrer une entreprise à taille humaine où confiance, innovation et esprit d'équipe sont au cœur de notre développement.

Les missions du poste

Rattaché(e) au Chief Business Development Officer, vous prenez en charge la définition et le pilotage de la stratégie de communication d’EDL Group, en cohérence avec ses ambitions de croissance, son positionnement et ses enjeux de transformation.

Votre quotidien dans nos équipes

Stratégie & pilotage de la communication Groupe

  • Piloter la stratégie de communication Groupe et sa déclinaison opérationnelle, en cohérence avec les ambitions business et les orientations stratégiques d’EDL.
  • Piloter le projet de rebranding du Groupe, en lien étroit avec la Direction Générale, de la définition du territoire de marque à son déploiement.
  • Structurer et déployer le plan de communication annuel Groupe, en définissant les priorités, audiences, messages clés et canaux.
  • Développer une approche cohérente de la communication à l’échelle du Groupe, en tenant compte des spécificités des différentes entités et marchés.
  • Garantir la cohérence du positionnement, de l’identité et des prises de parole d’EDL sur l’ensemble des supports et canaux.
  • Mettre en place les standards et principes de gouvernance de la communication Groupe et accompagner leur appropriation par les différentes entités.
  • Identifier les nouvelles opportunités de communication et anticiper les évolutions des usages et de l’écosystème.
  • Définir et suivre les KPI de notoriété et de performance et piloter le budget ainsi que les partenaires externes.

Marque, communication corporate & rayonnement du Groupe

  • Développer la visibilité, la notoriété et le rayonnement d’EDL Group auprès de ses clients, prospects, partenaires et de son écosystème.
  • Définir et piloter la ligne éditoriale et les prises de parole corporate du Groupe.
  • Superviser la production des contenus institutionnels et corporate : présentations Groupe, site web, newsletters, réseaux sociaux, vidéos, témoignages clients, interviews, etc.
  • Développer les relations avec les médias, partenaires et acteurs clés de l’écosystème.
  • Définir et déployer, en lien avec les équipes concernées, la stratégie événementielle du Groupe.
  • Piloter les agences et partenaires externes et garantir la qualité et la cohérence des livrables.

Communication interne & accompagnement de la transformation

  • Définir et structurer la stratégie de communication interne Groupe, en collaboration avec les équipes RH et les différentes entités.
  • Accompagner les projets stratégiques, de transformation et de croissance externe, en adaptant les messages et dispositifs aux différentes audiences.
  • Structurer les canaux, formats et rituels favorisant une communication fluide et transparente au sein du Groupe.
  • Accompagner les équipes et les managers dans les évolutions de l’organisation et contribuer au développement de la culture et de la marque employeur EDL.
  • Concevoir et coordonner les principaux événements internes Groupe et contribuer au renforcement de l’engagement et du sentiment d’appartenance.

Marketing & accompagnement du développement commercial

  • Contribuer à la définition et au déploiement du plan marketing, en cohérence avec la stratégie Groupe et les enjeux commerciaux.
  • Accompagner les équipes commerciales dans le développement de la visibilité des offres et de la génération de leads.
  • Piloter les analyses de marché, la veille concurrentielle et l’identification de nouvelles opportunités de développement.
  • Développer les outils et contenus d’aide à la vente et accompagner les lancements de nouvelles offres et solutions.
  • Mesurer la performance des actions marketing et communication et formuler des recommandations d’amélioration et d’optimisation.

Le profil recherché

Diplômé(e) d’une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en communication, marketing, école de commerce ou formation équivalente, vous justifiez idéalement de 8 et 10 ans d’expérience dans une fonction en communication et/ou marketing, avec une expérience significative en communication corporate, digitale et/ou stratégie de marque.

Vous avez une expérience dans le pilotage ou l’accompagnement de projets de rebranding, ainsi que dans la structuration et l’évolution d’une stratégie de communication. Vous maîtrisez la gestion de projets transverses dans un environnement international, et savez coordonner des interlocuteurs internes et externes dans un contexte de forte croissance, de transformation et d’évolution rapide. Une expérience dans le cadre d’opérations de croissance externe ou d’intégration constitue un véritable atout. Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise en pleine transformation et jouer un rôle clé dans la construction d’une marque Groupe forte, cohérente et visible, tout en restant proche des équipes et des enjeux business.

Vous êtes à la fois stratégique et opérationnel(le), autonome, structuré(e), pragmatique et force de proposition, avec une forte capacité à fédérer et à faire avancer les projets dans des environnements complexes et en mouvement.

Vous maitrisez l’anglais, l’allemand serait un plus.

Ce que nous vous proposons

Rejoindre EDL Group, c’est intégrer un Groupe en forte croissance, porté par l’innovation et une ambition de développement soutenue, dans un contexte d’accélération et de transformation lié à son projet de croissance et à son accompagnement par un fonds d’investissement. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement exigeant et stimulant, où l’initiative, l’autonomie et la capacité à faire bouger les lignes sont encouragées. Le poste offre une réelle opportunité de contribuer à des projets structurants et à fort impact, de participer à la construction d’une marque Groupe en pleine évolution et de prendre progressivement de nouvelles responsabilités au sein d’une organisation en développement. Chez EDL, nous valorisons la curiosité, l’esprit entrepreneurial, la collaboration et l’envie d’innover, avec la volonté de donner à chacun les moyens de grandir avec le Groupe.

Notre processus de recrutement

Votre candidature retient notre attention ?

Vous serez convié(e) à un entretien de préqualification RH avant de rencontrer nos équipes de direction Business Development et RH.

Nous nous engageons à vous apporter une réponse dans un délai de 15 jours après votre entretien.

title: Integration Consultant F/H
description:
As an Integration Consultant, you will contribute to the design, build, testing and deployment of integrations for UKG Pro WFM and related HR, Payroll and Workforce Management systems. You will work with customers, functional consultants and technical teams to understand integration requirements, transform data, configure integration flows, support testing activities and troubleshooting execution issues.

The role is suited for someone with prior experience in HRIS, WFM, Payroll, ERP or enterprise integration projects, and who is comfortable working with APIs, data files, middleware tools and customer-facing delivery. Prior experience with UKG Pro WFM or Boomi is valuable but not mandatory.

Vos missions

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze integration requirements and translate them into technical integration designs, mappings and configuration.
  • Build, configure or adapt integrations using Boomi, UKG templates, APIs, SFTP file exchanges and related integration tools.
  • Work with REST APIs, JSON, XML, CSV files, authentication mechanisms, error logs and integration execution reports.
  • Support testing cycles, investigate defects, reconcile source and target data, and document resolution steps.
  • Collaborate with HRIS, Payroll, Time & Attendance, Scheduling and Absence Management stakeholders to understand business context and downstream impacts.
  • Participate in client workshops, explain integration behavior clearly, and escalate risks or design decisions when needed.
  • Maintain integration documentation, mapping specifications, test evidence and deployment notes.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of templates, reusable components and delivery practices.

Vos compétences

Required Experience

  • 3-5 years of experience in integration, HRIS, WFM, Payroll, ERP or consulting projects.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one integration or middleware platform such as Boomi, SAP CPI, MuleSoft, Oracle Integration Cloud, Talend, Workato, Informatica, Azure Logic Apps or similar.
  • Practical understanding of REST APIs, JSON/XML, CSV files, SFTP, authentication, data mapping and error handling.
  • Previous exposure to HR, Payroll, Time & Attendance, Workforce Management or enterprise employee data flows.
  • Ability to troubleshoot integration issues, analyze logs and communicate findings to both technical and functional stakeholders.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work in a customer-facing environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with UKG Pro WFM, UKG Dimensions or other WFM platforms.
  • Experience with Boomi in an enterprise integration context.
  • Knowledge of Timekeeping, Scheduling, Absence Management, Accruals or Payroll interfaces.
  • Familiarity with Postman, SQL basics, SFTP, API testing and integration monitoring.
  • UKG, Boomi or related integration certifications.

Education

Degree in IT, Engineering, Business Systems, HRIS, Human Resources with proven technical experience.

title: Ad operations manager
description:
About Adcities

Adcities is redefining outdoor advertising by bringing digital-level targeting, measurement and attribution to the physical world.

Our platform leverages real-world signals, mobility data and contextual intelligence to deliver scalable, measurable OOH campaigns across global markets.

We partner with leading publishers and brands such as L’Oréal, Coca-Cola, Telefónica, to unlock the full potential of real-world media through technology.

We are present in the US, LATAM and now accelerating our international expansion in EMEA.

The role

As the ad operations manager, you will be responsible for planning, managing, and executing Adcities' advertising campaigns, implementing our ad manager platform utilities, and supervising campaign performance KPIs. Based in Paris, you will serve as the primary point of contact for agencies, clients, and creative teams once a deal is closed, ensuring a seamless customer journey from technical onboarding to final reconciliation.

This is a strategic and hands-on role at the intersection of account management and technical operations.

Tasks

What you will do

  • Campaign planning: lead the planning and execution of campaigns focusing on our contextual targeting capabilities.
  • Demand-side relations: act as the direct interlocutor for agencies and clients to implement campaigns closed by the sales team.
  • Supply-side operations: coordinate and manage relationships with media owners (OOH specialists, retail supports, etc.) to ensure correct campaign execution and inventory availability.
  • Document management: oversee key documentation for campaign coordination, including budgets, purchase orders (POs), technical specifications, and final creative assets.
  • End-to-end monitoring: control the full lifecycle of the campaign, ensuring correct data reconciliation for billing and payment management upon completion.
  • Analysis & reporting: support the sales team in presenting post-campaign reports, analyzing results, and verifying the fulfillment of established KPIs.
  • Tech stack management: efficiently manage our operations tools holded (Financial ERP), Adcities ad manager (proprietary technology), and Jira (project management).
  • International communication: maintain constant interaction with our global engineering and product teams to ensure technical alignment across time zones.
  • Operational efficiency: proactively seek process automation and alternative solutions to improve workflow autonomy.

Requirements

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in ad operations, account management, or technical campaign management within digital media or AdTech.
  • Deep understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem (programmatic, contextual, measurement) and OOH/DOOH market dynamics.
  • Technical proficiency: experience managing technical integrations and working alongside engineering or product teams.
  • Analytical mindset: excellent analytical skills, comfortable with performance data and reporting.
  • Communication: fluent in French and English. Knowledge of additional European languages is a plus.
  • Soft skills: highly organized, autonomous, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment.

A plus

  • Prior exposure to OOH or DOOH advertising
  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment
  • Familiarity with the French OOH/DOOH media landscape and key local publishers
  • Existing network within the French media agencies or brands

Benefits

Why join Adcities

  • Join a fast-growing Adtech startup at an early stage of its French expansion, with real opportunities to grow as the team scales
  • Work at the intersection of outdoor, data and AI as the category is being redefined
  • Work closely with experienced founders and a senior leadership team with a strong track record of building successful ventures
  • A competitive package
  • A company culture that is ambitious, transparent and genuinely international

Mach mit uns Schweizer Kleinunternehmen noch erfolgreicher! Klingt nach einer grossen Vision? Genau das treibt uns jeden Tag an.

  • Du spürst Schwachstellen in unseren Systemen präzise auf, bewertest die Risiken und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit den Teams nachhaltige Fixes.
  • Du dämmst Sicherheitsvorfälle souverän ein und behebst sie umgehend, um akute Bedrohungen für unsere Infrastruktur schnellstmöglich zu neutralisieren.

Dein Rucksack für diese Stelle

  • Du bringst idealerweise 2 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Security Engineering mit.
  • Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für moderne Sicherheitskonzepte, Vulnerability Management und gängige Frameworks (z. B. OWASP, CVSS, CVE).

  • Du bringst praktische Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), Versionierung (Git) sowie gängigen PenTesting- oder SIEM-Tools mit.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, proaktiv und teamübergreifend – und das auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau in Englisch (C1).

title: Software Engineer - Pirate & Architect
description:
As a Pirate

We’re not looking for a software engineer who works through tickets. We’re looking for someone who can identify, board, and take over a merchant vessel in record time, and who leaves behind a ship where every knot is flawless. AI now handles much of the design, prototyping, and coding. What matters is building fast without leaving chaos behind. Concretely:

  • Design thinking — you understand the actual problem before writing a single line of code
  • Rapid prototyping with AI — you don’t treat modern AI tools as a novelty but as a core part of your workflow, going from idea to working prototype in hours instead of weeks
  • Agentic coding with a firm hand — you let agents code for you, but you keep them on a short leash: strict architecture guidelines, clean design patterns, no sprawl
  • Speed with foresight — you build fast, but you’re already thinking two releases ahead. Every important design decision is documented and traceable, even when you built at sprint speed

As an Architect

Once the vessel is taken, you take command. Now structure matters more than speed.

  • Software & feature blueprinting — the plan exists before the building starts
  • Systems engineering — you think in systems, not isolated components
  • Software engineering design patterns — core toolkit, not bonus knowledge
  • Architecture design — you make and own the big decisions, and you know when a microservice earns its keep and when it's just overhead
  • Cloud-native product architecture — you design products for the cloud, not applications that happen to run there
  • Code reviews — held to a high standard, but constructive
  • Extreme attention to structure — loose ends are not a minor offense to you
  • Broad foundation across databases, data structures, storage, cloud functions, and infrastructure as code — you choose deliberately, not out of habit

Tasks

The work itself, concretely:

  • Building and maintaining AI agentic workflows — on industry-standard frameworks, with the same architectural discipline you would apply to any other production system
  • Building and maintaining data processing pipelines — ingestion, transformation and enrichment of customer data: reliable, observable, and safe to reprocess
  • Shipping features end to end — the React screen, the Python service behind it, and the AWS infrastructure it runs on
  • Making quality measurable — evaluation sets, tracing, and budgets for latency and cost, so a regression is caught by us and not by a customer
  • Integrating with our customers’ systems — real business data from real enterprise landscapes, rarely clean and never twice the same

Requirements

  • Multiple years of experience as a software engineer, ideally with ownership of architecture decisions
  • Practical, current experience with AI-assisted development (not just “tried it once”)
  • Understanding of cloud native architecture, ideally on AWS
  • End-to-end reach — ideally you are at home in the frontend, the backend and the infrastructure, and can take a feature all the way to production without handing it over at every boundary
  • The rare combination: high speed AND high structural discipline
  • Strong communication skills to explain and defend architecture decisions — including to agents that “wanted to solve it differently”

Benefits

✨ Shape and own the technical architecture as the company scales

✨ Work within a modern, AI-driven engineering setup

✨ High level of autonomy and real impact from day one

✨ Dynamic, entrepreneurial environment with room to grow

Send us resume / portfolio / GitHub / an example of a project you recently built using an AI-assisted workflow

No cover letter needed. Just show us you can board and clean up.

title: Founding Marketing Manager
description:
About Anthropos

Anthropos is the Enterprise AI transformation platform. We help companies map, verify, and develop the skills of their workforce with AI Simulations, AI Labs, AI Interviews, and our AI Academy. Enterprises in energy, transportation, and technology use us to answer a question no HR system can: what can our people actually do, and are they ready for AI?

We are a global team that has been building in the skills and assessment space for more than a decade. Most of us built and scaled a previous company in this exact market to a successful exit. Now we are doing it again, with AI at the core.

The role

You will be our first marketing hire, and you will own marketing.

There is no playbook to inherit and no team to delegate to on day one. You will work side by side with our CEO and founder and with the sales team, from our offices in Chiasso, and your job is to build the machine that grows our pipeline, our brand, and ultimately our revenue.

This is an operator role, not a strategy-only role. You will write the copy, ship the campaign, run the event, look at the data, and decide what to do next. If that excites you more than managing an agency, keep reading.

What you'll do

  • Demand generation. Design and run campaigns that put qualified enterprise buyers (CHROs, HR and Engineering leaders, CTOs) in front of our sales team. You own the pipeline number with them.
  • SEO and GEO. Grow our organic presence on search engines and inside AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity). Being found by AI is as important to us as being found by Google, and we are early enough that you can win here.
  • Events. Plan and run our presence at conferences, executive dinners, and our own events, end to end: pick them, organize them, work the room, follow up.
  • Content and brand. Shape how Anthropos sounds and looks in public: website, blog, LinkedIn, email, sales materials. Make the brand feel as good as the product.
  • Measurement. Instrument what you do, report on what worked, kill what didn't, and double down fast.
  • Structure. As things start working, turn them into repeatable processes and eventually into a team you help build.

Who you are

  • An entrepreneur at heart who knows marketing. You treat the function like your own business: you spot opportunities, act without waiting for permission, and own the outcome. Behind that instinct is real experience: years of generalist marketing in startups across demand gen, content, events, and product marketing, so you know which levers actually move pipeline.
  • Someone who gets things done. You are extremely operational. You default to doing, not briefing someone else to do, and you bring results fast. You like being measured on them.
  • An expert with Claude Code, or a heavy daily user of it. We use AI in a very advanced way across the whole company, and we expect marketing to work the same way: producing at a pace and volume a traditional marketer can't match. This is a real requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • Confident in a startup that moves very fast. We change direction quickly, the bar is high, and some days are stressful. In exchange, you will learn more in a year here than in five anywhere else. You need to genuinely want that trade.
  • A big risk-taker. You launch things that might fail, test channels nobody assigned you, and own the result either way.
  • Not looking for a nine-to-five. This is a startup job, and we are honest about what that means: we work quite a lot. If what you want is a predictable 9-to-5, this is not the right fit, and that's okay. If you want the intensity because of what you get to build, own, and learn, you will feel at home.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English, at a near-perfect level. Most of what you produce will be read by an international audience. Italian is a plus.
  • Able to work from our offices in Chiasso, Ticino. We work in person, with one remote day per week (Thursdays). Relocation support is available where possible.

What you'll get

  • CHF 42,000–50,000 per year, plus a very generous stock package. We'd rather be upfront: this is a startup salary paired with real ownership in the company, and the upside grows with the business you help build.
  • Relocation support, where available, if you are not already in the area.
  • The ability to grow very fast. You start as our first marketing hire; if you deliver, you build and lead the function. No queue of people ahead of you.
  • A direct working relationship with the founder and the sales team: short feedback loops, no layers.
  • The tools to work like it's the AI era: Claude Code, our own platform, and budget for what you need.

How we hire

We use our own product. The process: apply → complete an AI Simulation built for this role → meet the team → offer. It is fast, and you will experience exactly what we sell.

Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
description:
Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)


About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.

Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.


What you will do

Hands-on software development

•      You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data

•      You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams

•      You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform

•      You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow

•      You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure

•      You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software

•      You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection)

Mentorship & working with partners

•      You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow their technical skills

•      You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing

•      You work side by side with external development partners, challenging their choices and making sure the work meets a high standard

•      You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy

•      You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently

•      You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm


What you bring

Technical expertise

•      Extensive experience with C# and the .NET platform

•      Solid knowledge of software architecture, design principles and design patterns

•      Experience building web applications and REST APIs (ASP.NET)

•      Experience writing maintainable, testable, high-quality software

•      Experience with automated testing and CI/CD

•      The ability to mentor others and lift the level of a team

•      Good communication skills and the ability to clearly substantiate technical choices


A plus

•      Experience with cloud development, preferably Azure

•      Experience with machine learning and/or image recognition, and operationalising ML in production

•      Affinity with signal processing, measurement data and data streams, preferably in an industrial or technical context

•      Experience with WPF and complex desktop applications

•      Experience in a domain where software quality and reliability have direct impact (industrial automation, medical software, measurement & inspection or similar)

When do we see you as a senior?

For us, seniority goes beyond years of experience or technical skill. We are looking for someone who understands that technical choices affect the product, the organisation and our customers, and who actively takes responsibility for that.

You:

•      Form an independent view on architecture and technology

•      Think critically about requirements, assumptions and existing ways of working

•      Take responsibility for quality, also outside your own code, and recognise that in a safety-critical domain the bar is higher

•      Consciously build team knowledge: you document, explain and help colleagues grow

•      Are comfortable in an environment where not everything is fixed yet, and know how to bring structure to it

•      Actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team


What we offer

A senior role with real influence on our software products and how we build them, the chance to mentor and grow a team, and the variety of working alongside experienced external partners, in a domain where technology genuinely matters.


Salary & terms of employment

•      Gross monthly salary between € 5.328,- and € 6.715,- based on a 40-hour week, depending on knowledge and experience

•      Year-end bonus, dependent on company results

•      25 holiday days per year

•      Hybrid working (3 days per week at the office in Tricht as standard) and flexible working hours

•      Collective pension scheme, with Intero contributing 50% of the premium

•      Laptop and phone provided


Working environment

•      Technically challenging problems at the intersection of software, hardware and data

•      Collaboration with experienced specialists across a range of technical disciplines

•      Free fruit at work, access to the Intero Gym, company fitness options and a bike leasing scheme

•      An international, technically driven working environment with plenty of room for ownership and initiative


Ready to build with us?

Do you want to write excellent software, help a team grow around you and work alongside strong external partners? Then we would like to meet you.

With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Heb jij diepgaande ervaring in werktuigbouwkundige installaties en wil je bijdragen aan de meest kritische en innovatieve datacenterprojecten van dit moment? Als Senior Mechanical Engineer Datacenters bij Deerns werkt je aan high-tech, schaalbare en energie-efficiënte faciliteiten die de digitale wereld draaiend houden. Jij ontwerpt de installaties die maximale betrouwbaarheid, duurzaamheid en continuïteit waarborgen precies waar de datacentersector om vraagt.

 

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Mechanical Engineer binnen onze Datacenter afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de engineering en de technische coördinatie van complexe werktuigbouwkundige installaties. Denk aan geavanceerde koelconcepten (zoals indirect/direct evaporative cooling, liquid cooling en chiller‑oplossingen), luchtbehandeling, warmte‑terugwinning, water‑ en gassystemen en klimaattechnische infrastructuur die 24/7 betrouwbaar moet functioneren.

Vanaf de eerste conceptfase denk je mee over technische strategieën en ontwerpkeuzes die aansluiten op schaalbaarheid, energie‑efficiëntie, beschikbaarheidsnormen (Tier III/) en de steeds strengere duurzaamheidsdoelen. Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines zoals elektrotechniek, bouwkunde en security en bewaakt de technische integriteit en samenhang van het totaalontwerp. Dankzij jouw senioriteit fungeer je als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, ontwerpteams en leveranciers. Je stuurt waar nodig bij, begeleidt junior en medior engineers en draagt actief bij aan kennisontwikkeling binnen het datacenterteam.
 

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Ontwerpen van mechanische gebouw gebonden systemen, waaronder HVAC (verwarming, ventilatie en airconditioning), koeling en andere Datacenter specifieke installaties.

  • Meedenken in de concept‑ en ontwerpfase en vertalen van klantwensen naar haalbare en schaalbare technische oplossingen.

  • Coördineren van ontwerpactiviteiten met andere disciplines en bewaken van planning, kwaliteit en integrale samenhang.

  • Technisch aanspreekpunt zijn voor klanten, partners, leveranciers en interne stakeholders/junioren.

  • Begeleiden van engineers binnen het project en bijdragen aan kennisontwikkeling in het team.

  • Ondersteunen bij aanbestedingen, kostenramingen en kwaliteitscontroles (zowel ontwerp als uitvoering).

 

Waar werken we aan

We hebben meegewerkt aan de bouw van diverse nieuwe datacenters in o.a. Milaan, Amsterdam. We hebben ondersteuning geboden bij het ontwerp van de mechanische, elektrische en sanitaire installaties voor de bouw. Na het ontwerp van de mechanische, elektrische en sanitaire installaties heeft Deerns toezicht gehouden op de bouwplaats om de kwaliteit van de installaties te controleren en heeft het als Commissioning manager voor de hoofdaannemer gefungeerd. Deerns heeft ook ondersteuning geboden bij de bouw om een Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED)-certificering te behalen. LEED-certificering betekent dat een gebouw gezond en zeer efficiënt is en betere milieuprestaties levert.

Het team 

Je maakt onderdeel uit van een team met circa 16 collega’s, binnen de bredere organisatie waarin je meer dan 750 collega's in verschillende sectoren zal hebben. Het Data Center team is een hecht team dat bestaat uit projectmanagers, adviseurs, mechanical- en electrical engineers. De cultuur is open, kennis gedreven en gericht op samenwerking en plezier in het werk. Bovendien werk je in een hecht, integraal projectteam waarin ieders kennis en expertise optimaal wordt benut. Dit zorgt niet alleen voor sterke samenwerking, maar ook voor persoonlijke groei. De unit Datacenters werkt voornamelijk in opdracht van Colocattie providers, banken en grote bedrijven, zowel in Nederland als internationaal. Dit zorgt ervoor dat je aan gevarieerde projecten werkt en geen dag hetzelfde is. Daarnaast werk je regelmatig samen met onze units in Engeland, Spanje en Brazilie  waardoor je onderdeel bent van een sterk internationaal netwerk.


Dit ben jij 

  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde hbo- of wo‑opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Installatietechniek of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring (bij voorkeur 5+) als Mechanical Engineer binnen complexe gebouwgebonden installaties ervaring met datacenters of mission critical omgevingen is een sterke pre.

  • Je hebt ervaring met multidisciplinaire projectomgevingen en kunt uitstekend samenwerken met collega's uit andere vakgebieden.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer

Als Senior Electrical Engineer binnen onze Datacenter-afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de engineering en de technische coördinatie van complexe elektrotechnische installaties. Vanaf de eerste conceptfase denk je mee over technische strategieën en ontwerpkeuzes die aansluiten op schaalbaarheid, energie‑efficiëntie, beschikbaarheidsnormen (Tier III/IV) en steeds strengere duurzaamheidsdoelstellingen. Je werkt intensief samen met disciplines zoals werktuigbouwkunde, bouwkunde en security en bewaakt de technische samenhang van het integrale ontwerp. Dankzij jouw senioriteit fungeer je als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, ontwerpteams en leveranciers. Je stuurt waar nodig bij, begeleidt junior en medior engineers en draagt actief bij aan kennisontwikkeling binnen het datacenterteam.

Samen met multidisciplinaire projectteams geef je richting aan ontwerp en realisatie, met directe invloed op de dagelijkse operatie én de toekomstbestendigheid van luchthavens. Met jouw expertise en leiderschap til je niet alleen projecten, maar ook collega’s naar een hoger niveau.

De projecten waar je trots op kunt zijn

  • We werken aan het verduurzamen van Terminal 1 & 2 van Schiphol, zo’n 40% van de gehele terminal: De huidige installaties die zorgen voor een aangenaam binnenklimaat, maken gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen. Wij werken aan het ontwerp van de nieuwe installatie, die warmte en koude opslag combineert met warmtepompen zodat Schiphol energieneutraal de toekomst tegemoet kan. De uitdaging van dit project zit met name in het toepassen van nieuwe techniek in een bestaand gebouw waar ruimte moet worden gecreëerd om alle apparatuur en leidingen goed onder te brengen en te zorgen dat elke ruimte wordt voorzien van voldoende verwarming en koeling.   • We werken op Schiphol aan diverse grote en kleine projecten waarin klimaatbeheersing een grote rol speelt door intensiever gebruik van diverse ruimtes en toename van de apparatuur. title: Designer Working Student - Employer Branding
Senior AI Engineer
description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands.

  • You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together.

  • You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected.

  • You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law.

  • You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence.

  • You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early.

  • You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster.

  • You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts. You take ownership, show initiative when things aren’t yet clear and think from the customer’s problem. You enjoy helping others move forward without taking over. And you like working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

  • Extensive experience in software or ML engineering, around 5 years or more. Depth in recent projects counts for more than the number of years.

  • In-depth knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

  • You’ve built LLM applications and run them in production.

  • Solid experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or similar orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough.

  • You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

  • Strong backend experience, including REST APIs and Postgres databases.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

  • Experience in the legal, tax or another knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

  • A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

  • Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

  • Base salary between €5,500 and €6,450 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

  • A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

  • 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

  • A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

  • A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

  • Collective insurance plans.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

  • Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.
